entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, there's a guard up ahead... But is that[n]one of those you-know-whats there, too?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm getting that feeling again—that's[n]a you-know-what all right.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're in for a tough battle first, though.[n]You ready?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No problem. Take all the time you need[n]for us to be ready.

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Would you shut up about the you-know-[n]whats— Whoa, giant rats!

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: I'm gonna you-know-what the whole[n]lot of ya!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Whew... Thank goodness we didn't get[n]you-know-what'd.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah! And now that the path's clear,[n]let's grab that you-know-what!
